// diagnostic

E2804

Two routes both match `{method} {pattern}`.

What

Two routes both match `{method} {pattern}`.

Why

Pages, convention files, handler routes and marked methods share one route table, so two rows with one method and address make dispatch ambiguous and one of them would never be reached. A route added while the program runs is checked when it is added.

Fix

Remove one of the two registrations, rename the convention file, or make the addresses distinct (e.g. mount one under its own prefix).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2804: Tests/UI/http_route_ambiguous_overlap.stderr.

Error [jet.AmbiguousRoute]: Two routes both match `GET /jokes/:slug`.
  --> Tests/UI/http_route_ambiguous_overlap.jet:22:9
    |
 22 |     app.get("/jokes/:slug", fn(slug: String) { Ok(server.response(200, "joke {slug}")) })
    |         ^^^
  --> Tests/UI/http_route_ambiguous_overlap.jet:21:9
    |
 21 |     app.get("/jokes/:id", fn(id: Int) { Ok(server.response(200, "joke {id}")) })
    |         ^^^ first registered here
 Why: Pages, convention files, handler routes and marked methods share one route table, so two rows with one method and address make dispatch ambiguous and one of them would never be reached. A route added while the program runs is checked when it is added.
 Fix: Remove one of the two registrations, rename the convention file, or make the addresses distinct (e.g. mount one under its own prefix).
